ADD_PLANE.name: Add Plane
ADD_PLANE.description: Add a four-vertex plane at the 3D Cursor. Useful as a starting surface for modeling.

ADD_CUBE.name: Add Cube
ADD_CUBE.description: Add a cube mesh at the 3D Cursor.

SEARCH_ADD_MENU.name: Search Add Menu
SEARCH_ADD_MENU.description: Open Blender’s searchable Add menu so you can search for any available object or primitive.

ADD_MENU.name: Add Menu
ADD_MENU.description: Open Blender’s standard Add menu in the 3D Viewport.

ADD_CYLINDER.name: Add Cylinder
ADD_CYLINDER.description: Add a cylinder mesh at the 3D Cursor.

ADD_UVSPHERE.name: Add UVSphere
ADD_UVSPHERE.description: Add a UV sphere mesh at the 3D Cursor.

ADD_CONE.name: Add Cone
ADD_CONE.description: Add a cone mesh at the 3D Cursor.

ADD_GRID.name: Add Grid
ADD_GRID.description: Add a subdivided grid mesh at the 3D Cursor.

ROTATION.name: Rotation
ROTATION.description: Apply the active object’s rotation to its mesh data. The object keeps its current appearance but its rotation values are reset.

ALL_TRANSFORMS.name: All Transforms
ALL_TRANSFORMS.description: Apply location, rotation and scale to the object’s data, resetting those transform values while preserving the visible result.

ROTATION_AND_SCALE.name: Rotation & Scale
ROTATION_AND_SCALE.description: Apply rotation and scale to the object’s data while leaving its location unchanged.

LOCATION_AND_SCALE.name: Location & Scale
LOCATION_AND_SCALE.description: Apply location and scale to the object’s data while leaving its rotation unchanged.

LOCATION_AND_ROTATION.name: Location & Rotation
LOCATION_AND_ROTATION.description: Apply location and rotation to the object’s data while leaving its scale unchanged.

APPLY_TRANSFORMS_MENU.name: Apply Transforms Menu
APPLY_TRANSFORMS_MENU.description: Open Blender’s Apply menu to choose which object transforms to apply.

LOCATION.name: Location
LOCATION.description: Apply the object’s location to its data, resetting its location values while preserving its visible position.

SCALE.name: Scale
SCALE.description: Apply the object’s scale to its data, resetting scale values while preserving its visible size.

SUBDIVISION.name: SubDivision
SUBDIVISION.description: Add a Subdivision Surface modifier to smooth and subdivide the object non-destructively.

MIRROR.name: Mirror
MIRROR.description: Add a Mirror modifier to create mirrored geometry across its configured axes.

MODIFIER_SEARCH.name: Modifier Search
MODIFIER_SEARCH.description: Open Blender’s searchable modifier list. Type a modifier name to find and add it.

MULTIRES.name: Multires
MULTIRES.description: Add a Multiresolution modifier, allowing the mesh to be subdivided and sculpted at multiple detail levels.

SOLIDIFY.name: Solidify
SOLIDIFY.description: Add a Solidify modifier to give a surface mesh thickness.

DISPLACE.name: Displace
DISPLACE.description: Add a Displace modifier that offsets vertices using a texture.

SHRINKWRAP.name: Shrinkwrap
SHRINKWRAP.description: Add a Shrinkwrap modifier that projects the mesh onto a target surface once a target is assigned.

ARRAY.name: Array
ARRAY.description: Add the Geometry Nodes Array asset, which repeats geometry in an array-like pattern.

SELECT_ALL.name: Select All
SELECT_ALL.description: Select every selectable object in the current view layer.

INVERT_SELECTION.name: Invert Selection
INVERT_SELECTION.description: Invert object selection: selected objects become deselected and unselected objects become selected.

RENAME_OBJECT.name: Rename Object
RENAME_OBJECT.description: Open the object name editing panel for the active object.

MOVE_TO_COLLECTION.name: Move To Collection
MOVE_TO_COLLECTION.description: Open the collection menu to move selected objects into another collection.

UNHIDE_ALL.name: Unhide All
UNHIDE_ALL.description: Make all hidden objects visible again without changing their selection state.

SOLO_OBJECT.name: Solo Object
SOLO_OBJECT.description: Isolate selected objects by hiding unselected objects in the viewport.

HIDE_SELECTED.name: Hide Selected
HIDE_SELECTED.description: Hide selected objects in the viewport.

CURSOR_TOOL.name: Cursor Tool
CURSOR_TOOL.description: Activate the 3D Cursor tool for placing or moving the 3D Cursor.

LASSO_SELECT.name: Lasso Select
LASSO_SELECT.description: Activate the freehand Lasso Select tool.

TWEAK_TOOL.name: Tweak Tool
TWEAK_TOOL.description: Activate the Select/Tweak tool for selecting and dragging elements.

ADD_CUBE_TOOL.name: Add Cube Tool
ADD_CUBE_TOOL.description: Activate the interactive Add Cube tool. Click and drag in the viewport to create a cube.

ADD_CYLINDER_TOOL.name: Add Cylinder Tool
ADD_CYLINDER_TOOL.description: Activate the interactive Add Cylinder tool. Click and drag in the viewport to create a cylinder.

SHADING_MENU.name: Shading Menu
SHADING_MENU.description: Open the viewport shading popover for changing shading mode, lighting and display options.

WIREFRAME.name: Wireframe
WIREFRAME.description: Switch the viewport to Wireframe shading so mesh edges and vertices are visible through surfaces.

SOLID.name: Solid
SOLID.description: Switch the viewport to Solid shading for fast, untextured modeling display.

STUDIO.name: Studio
STUDIO.description: Set viewport lighting to Studio mode. Studio lighting uses Blender’s studio light environment.

MATCAP.name: Matcap
MATCAP.description: Set viewport lighting to MatCap mode, using a material-capture sphere to shade the model.

FLAT.name: Flat
FLAT.description: Set viewport lighting to Flat mode, removing studio-light shading variation.

MATERIAL.name: Material
MATERIAL.description: Switch the viewport to Material Preview so material shaders and lighting can be previewed.

RENDERED.name: Rendered
RENDERED.description: Switch the viewport to Rendered shading to preview the scene using the active render engine.

TOP.name: Top
TOP.description: Align the view to look straight down the world Z axis.

FRONT.name: Front
FRONT.description: Align the view to the front (looking along the world Y axis).

RIGHT.name: Right
RIGHT.description: Align the view to the right side of the scene.

BOTTOM.name: Bottom
BOTTOM.description: Align the view to look upward from below the scene.

LEFT.name: Left
LEFT.description: Align the view to the left side of the scene.

BACK.name: Back
BACK.description: Align the view to the back of the scene.

VIEW_MAXIMIZE.name: View Maximize
VIEW_MAXIMIZE.description: Toggle the current editor area between normal layout and full-area view.

VIEW_SELECTED.name: View Selected
VIEW_SELECTED.description: Frame the selected objects or mesh elements in the 3D Viewport.

OBJECT_MODE.name: Object Mode
OBJECT_MODE.description: Switch the active object to Object Mode.

TEXTURE_PAINT_MODE.name: Texture Paint Mode
TEXTURE_PAINT_MODE.description: Switch the active object to Texture Paint Mode.

EDIT_MODE.name: Edit Mode
EDIT_MODE.description: Switch the active mesh object to Edit Mode.

SCULPT_MODE.name: Sculpt Mode
SCULPT_MODE.description: Switch the active mesh object to Sculpt Mode.

WEIGHT_PAINT_MODE.name: Weight Paint Mode
WEIGHT_PAINT_MODE.description: Switch the active object to Weight Paint Mode.

VERTEX_PAINT_MODE.name: Vertex Paint Mode
VERTEX_PAINT_MODE.description: Switch the active mesh object to Vertex Paint Mode.

INCREASE_SUBDIVISION.name: Increase Subdivision
INCREASE_SUBDIVISION.description: Increase the Subdivision Surface modifier’s viewport subdivision level by one.

INCREASE_RENDER_LEVEL.name: Increase Render Level
INCREASE_RENDER_LEVEL.description: Increase the Subdivision Surface modifier’s render subdivision level by one.

DECREASE_SUBDIVISION.name: Decrease Subdivision
DECREASE_SUBDIVISION.description: Decrease the Subdivision Surface modifier’s viewport subdivision level by one.

DECREASE_RENDER_LEVEL.name: Decrease Render Level
DECREASE_RENDER_LEVEL.description: Decrease the Subdivision Surface modifier’s render subdivision level by one.

SHOW_IN_VIEWPORT.name: Show In Viewport
SHOW_IN_VIEWPORT.description: Toggle whether the Subdivision Surface modifier affects the 3D Viewport.

SHOW_IN_EDITMODE.name: Show In EditMode
SHOW_IN_EDITMODE.description: Toggle whether the Subdivision Surface modifier is displayed in Edit Mode.

SHOW_IN_RENDER.name: Show In Render
SHOW_IN_RENDER.description: Toggle whether the Subdivision Surface modifier is evaluated during rendering.

SHOW_CAGE.name: Show Cage
SHOW_CAGE.description: Toggle display of the modifier edit cage so the editable cage follows the evaluated surface.

VERT_SELECT.name: Vert Select
VERT_SELECT.description: Switch mesh selection to vertices only.

EDGE_SELECT.name: Edge Select
EDGE_SELECT.description: Switch mesh selection to edges only.

FACE_SELECT.name: Face Select
FACE_SELECT.description: Switch mesh selection to faces only.

SELECT_ALL_93DF52.name: Select All
SELECT_ALL_93DF52.description: Select all vertices, edges and faces in the mesh.

DESELECT_ALL_CB73F0.name: Deselect All
DESELECT_ALL_CB73F0.description: Deselect all selected vertices, edges and faces.

LOOP_INNER_REGION.name: Loop Inner Region
LOOP_INNER_REGION.description: Select the region enclosed by the current edge-loop selection.

SELECT_MIRROR.name: Select Mirror
SELECT_MIRROR.description: Select corresponding mirrored elements across the mesh symmetry plane, extending the current selection.

HIDE_SELECTED_76F040.name: Hide Selected
HIDE_SELECTED_76F040.description: Hide selected mesh elements in Edit Mode.

UNHIDE_ALL_396850.name: UnHide All
UNHIDE_ALL_396850.description: Reveal all hidden mesh elements in Edit Mode.

SOLO_SELECTED.name: Solo Selected
SOLO_SELECTED.description: Hide unselected mesh elements, leaving the selected geometry visible.

SELECT_NON_MANIFOLD.name: Select Non Manifold
SELECT_NON_MANIFOLD.description: Select non-manifold edges, such as boundary edges and edges shared by an invalid number of faces.

SELECT_SHARP_EDGES.name: Select Sharp Edges
SELECT_SHARP_EDGES.description: Select edges whose angle between adjacent faces is considered sharp.

CHECKER_DESELECT.name: Checker Deselect
CHECKER_DESELECT.description: Apply checker deselection to the current selection, deselecting alternating elements according to the operator settings.

SELECT_SIMILAR.name: Select Similar
SELECT_SIMILAR.description: Select mesh elements similar to the active selection, using Blender’s similarity criteria.

SELECT_LINKED.name: Select Linked
SELECT_LINKED.description: Select connected geometry under the mouse cursor, expanding to its linked component.

EDGE_DELETE.name: Edge Delete
EDGE_DELETE.description: Delete selected edges and the geometry connected to those edges according to Blender’s Edge delete operation.

FACE_DELETE.name: Face Delete
FACE_DELETE.description: Delete selected faces. Boundary edges and vertices may remain, depending on surrounding topology.

ONLY_FACE.name: Only Face
ONLY_FACE.description: Delete selected faces only, preserving their surrounding edges and vertices.

FACE_DISSOLVE.name: Face Dissolve
FACE_DISSOLVE.description: Dissolve selected faces while preserving surrounding geometry where possible, removing the face boundaries.

EDGE_DISSOLVE.name: Edge Dissolve
EDGE_DISSOLVE.description: Dissolve selected edges and merge adjacent faces where possible, preserving the surrounding surface.

VERTICES_DISSOLVE.name: Vertices Dissolve
VERTICES_DISSOLVE.description: Dissolve selected vertices and their connected edges while preserving surrounding faces where possible.

EDGE_AND_FACE.name: Edge & Face
EDGE_AND_FACE.description: Delete selected edges and faces together.

VERTICES_DELETE.name: Vertices Delete
VERTICES_DELETE.description: Delete selected vertices and the edges and faces connected to them.

SEPARATE_SELECTION.name: Separate Selection
SEPARATE_SELECTION.description: Separate the selected geometry into a new object.

SEPARATE_LOOSE_GEOMETRY.name: Separate Loose Geometry
SEPARATE_LOOSE_GEOMETRY.description: Split disconnected loose parts into separate objects.

SEPARATE_BY_MATERIAL.name: Separate By Material
SEPARATE_BY_MATERIAL.description: Separate mesh geometry into objects according to its assigned material slots.

MERGE_BY_DISTANCE.name: Merge By Distance
MERGE_BY_DISTANCE.description: Merge vertices that are closer than the configured distance, removing duplicate or overlapping vertices.

AT_CENTER.name: At Center
AT_CENTER.description: Merge selected vertices at the center of their combined positions.

AT_FIRST.name: At First
AT_FIRST.description: Merge selected vertices at the position of the first selected vertex.

AT_CURSOR.name: At Cursor
AT_CURSOR.description: Merge selected vertices at the 3D Cursor position.

AT_LAST.name: At Last
AT_LAST.description: Merge selected vertices at the position of the last selected vertex.

RIP_VERTICES.name: Rip Vertices
RIP_VERTICES.description: Rip selected vertices away from connected geometry, creating an opening in the mesh.

VERTEX_SLIDE.name: Vertex Slide
VERTEX_SLIDE.description: Slide selected vertices along their connected edges without freely moving them through space.

EXTRUDE_VERTICES.name: Extrude Vertices
EXTRUDE_VERTICES.description: Extrude selected vertices to create new vertices and connecting edges.

MERGE_AT_CENTER.name: Merge At Center
MERGE_AT_CENTER.description: Merge selected vertices at the center of their combined positions.

FILL_FACE.name: Fill Face
FILL_FACE.description: Create a face from the selected boundary edges or vertices.

KNIFE_TOOL.name: Knife Tool
KNIFE_TOOL.description: Activate the Knife tool for drawing cuts directly across the mesh.

JOIN_VERTICES.name: Join Vertices
JOIN_VERTICES.search_name: Connect Vertices with an Edge Path
JOIN_VERTICES.description: Connect selected vertices with an edge path.

VERTEX_BEVEL.name: Vertex Bevel
VERTEX_BEVEL.description: Bevel selected vertices, cutting back corners and creating additional geometry around each vertex.

LOOP_CUT_SLIDE.name: Loop Cut Slide
LOOP_CUT_SLIDE.description: Insert an edge loop and immediately slide it to position the new loop.

LOOP_CUT.name: Loop Cut
LOOP_CUT.description: Insert an edge loop through connected quad faces.

EDGE_BEVEL.name: Edge Bevel
EDGE_BEVEL.description: Bevel selected edges with the preset of one segment and a rounded profile.

FLAT_BEVEL.name: Flat Bevel
FLAT_BEVEL.description: Bevel selected edges with two segments and a flat profile.

EXTRUDE_EDGES.name: Extrude Edges
EXTRUDE_EDGES.description: Extrude selected edges to create new edges and connecting faces where possible.

EDGE_SLIDE.name: Edge Slide
EDGE_SLIDE.description: Slide selected edges along their adjacent faces while maintaining connectivity.

BRIDGE_EDGELOOPS.name: Bridge EdgeLoops
BRIDGE_EDGELOOPS.description: Create faces between two selected edge loops, connecting their boundaries.

MARK_SHARP.name: Mark Sharp
MARK_SHARP.description: Mark selected edges as sharp for split-normal and shading control.

CLEAR_SHARP.name: Clear Sharp
CLEAR_SHARP.description: Remove the sharp mark from selected edges.

MARK_SEAM.name: Mark Seam
MARK_SEAM.description: Mark selected edges as UV seams for later UV unwrapping.

CLEAR_SEAM.name: Clear Seam
CLEAR_SEAM.description: Remove UV seam marks from selected edges.

EDGE_BEVEL_WEIGHT.name: Edge Bevel Weight
EDGE_BEVEL_WEIGHT.description: Open the bevel-weight transform for selected edges so their bevel influence can be adjusted.

CLEAR_BEVEL_WEIGHT.name: Clear Bevel Weight
CLEAR_BEVEL_WEIGHT.description: Set the bevel weight of selected edges to zero.

EDGE_CREASE.name: Edge Crease
EDGE_CREASE.description: Open the edge-crease adjustment popup for selected edges. The initial factor is zero; adjust it in the popup.

CLEAR_EDGE_CREASE.name: Clear Edge Crease
CLEAR_EDGE_CREASE.description: Set the crease value of selected edges to zero.

POKE.name: Poke
POKE.description: Poke selected faces by adding a vertex at each face center and connecting it to the face boundary.

EXTRUDE_FACES.name: Extrude Faces
EXTRUDE_FACES.description: Extrude selected faces, creating new surface geometry connected to the original boundary.

INSET.name: Inset
INSET.description: Inset selected faces by creating an inner boundary and a surrounding border.

SHADE_FACE_SMOOTH.name: Shade Face Smooth
SHADE_FACE_SMOOTH.description: Set selected faces to smooth shading.

SHADE_FACE_FLAT.name: Shade Face Flat
SHADE_FACE_FLAT.description: Set selected faces to flat shading.

GRID_FILL.name: Grid Fill
GRID_FILL.description: Fill a boundary loop with a grid of quad faces.

EXTRUDE_ALONG_NORMALS.name: Extrude Along Normals
EXTRUDE_ALONG_NORMALS.description: Extrude selected faces along their individual face normals.

FOLLOW_ACTIVE_QUADS.name: Follow Active Quads
FOLLOW_ACTIVE_QUADS.description: Unwrap selected quad faces by following the shape and UV orientation of the active quad.

UV_RESET.name: UV Reset
UV_RESET.description: Reset UV coordinates for the selected faces using the mesh’s reset projection.

SMART_PROJECT.name: Smart Project
SMART_PROJECT.description: Generate UV islands automatically using angle-based projection and island packing.

UNWRAP_CONFORMAL.name: Unwrap Conformal
UNWRAP_CONFORMAL.description: Unwrap the selected mesh using Blender’s Conformal method, which prioritizes angular preservation.

UNWRAP_MINIMUM_STRETCH.name: Unwrap Minimum Stretch
UNWRAP_MINIMUM_STRETCH.description: Unwrap the selected mesh using the Minimum Stretch method to reduce UV distortion.

UNWRAP_ANGLE_BASED.name: Unwrap Angle Based
UNWRAP_ANGLE_BASED.description: Unwrap the selected mesh using the Angle Based method, suited to organic shapes.

BOX_SELECT_TOOL.name: Box Select Tool
BOX_SELECT_TOOL.description: Activate the rectangular Box Select tool.

LASSO_SELECT_TOOL.name: Lasso Select Tool
LASSO_SELECT_TOOL.description: Activate the freehand Lasso Select tool.

CIRCLE_SELECT_TOOL.name: Circle Select Tool
CIRCLE_SELECT_TOOL.description: Activate the brush-like Circle Select tool.

ORIGIN_TO_GEOMETRY.name: Origin To Geometry
ORIGIN_TO_GEOMETRY.description: Move the object origin to the center of its geometry while keeping the mesh in place.

CURSOR_TO_ORIGIN.name: Cursor To Origin
CURSOR_TO_ORIGIN.description: Move the 3D Cursor to the world origin (0, 0, 0).

SELECTED_TO_CURSOR.name: Selected To Cursor
SELECTED_TO_CURSOR.description: Move selected mesh geometry to the 3D Cursor, preserving its relative arrangement.

GEOMETRY_TO_ORIGIN.name: Geometry To Origin
GEOMETRY_TO_ORIGIN.description: Move the mesh geometry so that the object origin becomes the center of the geometry.

ORIGIN_TO_SELECTED.name: Origin To Selected
ORIGIN_TO_SELECTED.description: Move the object origin to the current selection while keeping the mesh in place.

CURSOR_TO_SELECTED.name: Cursor To Selected
CURSOR_TO_SELECTED.description: Place the 3D Cursor at the center of the current mesh selection.

ORIGIN_TO_CURSOR.name: Origin To Cursor
ORIGIN_TO_CURSOR.description: Move the object origin to the 3D Cursor while keeping the mesh in place.

INITIALIZE_RETOPO.name: Initialize Retopo
INITIALIZE_RETOPO.description: Prepare the active mesh for AllPie retopology: store it as the retopo mesh and enable the retopology viewport overlay and face-project snapping.

WELD_TOPOLOGY_BRUSH.name: Weld Topology Brush
WELD_TOPOLOGY_BRUSH.description: Start the interactive retopology weld tool. Drag a retopology vertex toward nearby vertices to weld them together.

RELAX_TOPOLOGY_BRUSH.name: Relax Topology Brush
RELAX_TOPOLOGY_BRUSH.description: Start the interactive retopology relax brush to even out vertex spacing while maintaining the surface shape.

STRIPS_TOOL.name: Strips Tool
STRIPS_TOOL.description: Draw a guide stroke on the target surface to generate a snapped strip of quad polygons.

STROKES_TOOL.name: Strokes Tool
STROKES_TOOL.description: Draw multiple guide strokes to generate quad topology between the guides.

DRAW_SHARP.name: DRAW SHARP
DRAW_SHARP.description: Activate the Draw Sharp sculpt brush. It builds or cuts narrow, sharp surface features along the stroke.

INFLATE.name: INFLATE
INFLATE.description: Activate the Inflate / Deflate sculpt brush. It pushes the surface outward or inward along surface normals.

PINCH.name: PINCH
PINCH.description: Activate the Pinch / Magnify sculpt brush. It pulls surface points toward the stroke center or expands them away from it.

GRAB.name: GRAB
GRAB.description: Activate the Grab sculpt brush for dragging and repositioning a broad region of the surface.

SCRAPE.name: SCRAPE
SCRAPE.description: Activate the Scrape / Fill sculpt brush to flatten protruding areas or fill recessed areas toward a plane.

CLAY_STRIPS.name: CLAY STRIPS
CLAY_STRIPS.description: Activate the Clay Strips sculpt brush to build volume in layered, strip-like strokes.

DRAW.name: DRAW
DRAW.description: Activate the Draw sculpt brush to add or remove volume along the stroke.

MASK.name: MASK
MASK.description: Activate the Mask brush to paint a mask that protects parts of the mesh from sculpting.

SNAKE_HOOK.name: SNAKE HOOK
SNAKE_HOOK.description: Activate the Snake Hook brush to pull and stretch mesh geometry from the stroke start.

ASSET_SHELF.name: ASSET SHELF
ASSET_SHELF.description: Open the Sculpt brush Asset Shelf to browse and activate available brush assets.

ERASE_MULTIRES_DISPLACEMENT.name: ERASE MULTIRES DISPLACEMENT
ERASE_MULTIRES_DISPLACEMENT.description: Activate the Erase Multires Displacement brush to erase sculpt displacement on a Multiresolution mesh.

RELAX_SLIDE.name: RELAX SLIDE
RELAX_SLIDE.description: Activate the Relax Slide brush to even out local vertex spacing while relaxing the surface.

FACE_SET_PAINT.name: FACE SET PAINT
FACE_SET_PAINT.description: Activate the Face Set Paint brush to paint and assign Face Set regions.

TRIM.name: TRIM
TRIM.description: Activate the Trim brush for trimming mesh regions using a brush stroke.

CLAY.name: CLAY
CLAY.description: Activate the Clay sculpt brush to build up volume with broad clay-like strokes.

CREASE_SHARP.name: CREASE SHARP
CREASE_SHARP.description: Activate the Crease Sharp brush to carve narrow creases and create sharp ridges.

AIRBRUSH.name: Airbrush
AIRBRUSH.description: Activate the Airbrush preset from Blender’s sculpt brush assets.

PAINT_SQUARE.name: Paint Square
PAINT_SQUARE.description: Activate the Paint Square preset from Blender’s sculpt brush assets.

PAINT_SOFT.name: Paint Soft
PAINT_SOFT.description: Activate the Paint Soft preset from Blender’s sculpt brush assets.

PAINT_HARD.name: Paint Hard
PAINT_HARD.description: Activate the Paint Hard preset from Blender’s sculpt brush assets.

PAINT_BLEND.name: Paint Blend
PAINT_BLEND.description: Activate the Paint Blend preset from Blender’s sculpt brush assets.

PAINT_SOFT_PRESSURE.name: Paint Soft Pressure
PAINT_SOFT_PRESSURE.description: Activate the Paint Soft Pressure preset from Blender’s sculpt brush assets.

PAINT_HARD_PRESSURE.name: Paint Hard Pressure
PAINT_HARD_PRESSURE.description: Activate the Paint Hard Pressure preset from Blender’s sculpt brush assets.

BRUSH_STROKE_MENU.name: Brush Stroke Menu
BRUSH_STROKE_MENU.description: Open brush stroke settings, including stroke method, spacing, jitter and related behavior.

BRUSH_SETTING_MENU.name: Brush Setting Menu
BRUSH_SETTING_MENU.description: Open advanced brush settings for the active sculpt brush.

BRUSH_TEXTURE_MENU.name: Brush Texture Menu
BRUSH_TEXTURE_MENU.description: Open texture settings for the active sculpt brush.

AUTOMASKING_CAVITY.name: AutoMasking Cavity
AUTOMASKING_CAVITY.description: Toggle sculpt auto-masking based on surface cavities. The brush is restricted by cavity areas when enabled.

AUTOMASKING_CAVITY_INVERTED.name: AutoMasking Cavity Inverted
AUTOMASKING_CAVITY_INVERTED.description: Toggle inverted cavity auto-masking, applying the cavity mask to the inverse of the cavity regions.

AUTOMASKING_FACESET.name: AutoMasking Faceset
AUTOMASKING_FACESET.description: Toggle auto-masking by Face Sets so sculpting is constrained by Face Set boundaries.

AUTOMASKING_TOPOLOGY.name: AutoMasking Topology
AUTOMASKING_TOPOLOGY.description: Toggle topology auto-masking so the brush respects connected mesh topology.

TOGGLE_STABILIZE_STROKE.name: Toggle Stabilize Stroke
TOGGLE_STABILIZE_STROKE.description: Toggle stabilized strokes on the active sculpt brush to smooth mouse or tablet movement.

SET_VOXEL_SIZE.name: Set Voxel Size
SET_VOXEL_SIZE.description: Open Blender’s Voxel Size control for adjusting the voxel resolution used by Voxel Remesh.

REMESH_MENU.name: Remesh Menu
REMESH_MENU.description: Open the Sculpt Voxel Remesh settings panel.

QUADRIFLOW_REMESH.name: Quadriflow Remesh
QUADRIFLOW_REMESH.description: Open AllPie’s custom QuadriFlow remesh operator to generate quad-based topology from the current mesh.

INCREASE_VOXELSIZE_25.name: Increase VoxelSize 25%
INCREASE_VOXELSIZE_25.description: Increase the active mesh’s voxel size by 25%, producing a coarser voxel remesh.

INCREASE_VOXELSIZE_10.name: Increase VoxelSize 10%
INCREASE_VOXELSIZE_10.description: Increase the active mesh’s voxel size by 10%, producing a slightly coarser voxel remesh.

REMESH.name: REMESH
REMESH.description: Run Voxel Remesh on the active mesh using its current voxel size and remesh settings.

DECREASE_VOXELSIZE_25.name: Decrease VoxelSize 25%
DECREASE_VOXELSIZE_25.description: Decrease the active mesh’s voxel size by 25%, producing a finer voxel remesh.

DECREASE_VOXELSIZE_10.name: Decrease VoxelSize 10%
DECREASE_VOXELSIZE_10.description: Decrease the active mesh’s voxel size by 10%, producing a slightly finer voxel remesh.

SYMMETRY_MENU.name: Symmetry Menu
SYMMETRY_MENU.description: Open Sculpt symmetry settings for axis mirroring and symmetrize direction.

SYMMETRIZE.name: Symmetrize
SYMMETRIZE.search_name: Mirror Geometry Across the Symmetry Plane
SYMMETRIZE.description: Symmetrize the mesh by copying geometry from one side across the configured symmetry plane.

Z_SYMMETRY.name: Z Symmetry
Z_SYMMETRY.description: Toggle sculpt stroke mirroring across the Z axis.

Y_SYMMETRY.name: Y Symmetry
Y_SYMMETRY.description: Toggle sculpt stroke mirroring across the Y axis.

X_SYMMETRY.name: X Symmetry
X_SYMMETRY.description: Toggle sculpt stroke mirroring across the X axis.

FLIP_X.name: Flip X
FLIP_X.description: Switch the X symmetrize direction between positive-to-negative and negative-to-positive.

FLIP_Y.name: Flip Y
FLIP_Y.description: Switch the Y symmetrize direction between positive-to-negative and negative-to-positive.

FLIP_Z.name: Flip Z
FLIP_Z.description: Switch the Z symmetrize direction between positive-to-negative and negative-to-positive.

DELETE_HIGHER.name: Delete Higher
DELETE_HIGHER.description: Delete Multiresolution levels above the current base level.

APPLY_TO_BASE.name: Apply To Base
APPLY_TO_BASE.search_name: Apply Multiresolution Detail to Base Mesh
APPLY_TO_BASE.description: Apply the Multiresolution modifier’s sculpted displacement to the base mesh.

INCREASE_SCULPT_LEVEL.name: Increase Sculpt Level
INCREASE_SCULPT_LEVEL.description: Increase the Multiresolution modifier’s sculpt level by one, up to the highest available level.

INCREASE_VEIWPORT_LEVEL.name: Increase Veiwport Level
INCREASE_VEIWPORT_LEVEL.description: Increase the Multiresolution modifier’s viewport display level by one.

SUBDIVIDE.name: Subdivide
SUBDIVIDE.description: Subdivide the Multiresolution modifier once, adding another detail level.

DECREASE_SCULPT_LEVEL.name: Decrease Sculpt Level
DECREASE_SCULPT_LEVEL.description: Decrease the Multiresolution modifier’s sculpt level by one.

DECREASE_VIEWPORT_LEVEL.name: Decrease Viewport Level
DECREASE_VIEWPORT_LEVEL.description: Decrease the Multiresolution modifier’s viewport display level by one.

SET_RENDER_LEVEL.name: Set Render Level
SET_RENDER_LEVEL.search_name: Set Render Level to Sculpt Level
SET_RENDER_LEVEL.description: Set the Multiresolution render level to match the current sculpt level.

RESET_PIVOT.name: Reset Pivot
RESET_PIVOT.search_name: Reset Sculpt Pivot to Object Origin
RESET_PIVOT.description: Set the sculpt pivot position back to the object origin.

COLOR_PICKER.name: Color Picker
COLOR_PICKER.description: Open AllPie’s sculpt brush color popup for primary/secondary color selection and palette access.

MASK_LASSO.name: Mask Lasso
MASK_LASSO.description: Activate the Lasso Mask tool for painting a freehand mask region.

MASK_LINE.name: Mask Line
MASK_LINE.description: Activate the Line Mask tool for drawing a straight mask stroke.

SET_PIVOT.name: Set Pivot
SET_PIVOT.description: Set the sculpt pivot position to the surface under the cursor.

GROW_VISIBILITY.name: Grow Visibility
GROW_VISIBILITY.description: Expand the visible mesh region by one visibility step, revealing adjacent hidden geometry.

SHRINK_VISIBILITY.name: Shrink Visibility
SHRINK_VISIBILITY.description: Shrink the visible mesh region by one visibility step, hiding boundary geometry.

HIDE_LASSO.name: Hide Lasso
HIDE_LASSO.description: Activate the Lasso Hide tool for hiding a freehand region of the mesh.

HIDE_MASKED.name: Hide Masked
HIDE_MASKED.description: Hide mesh geometry covered by the current sculpt mask.

SOLO_FACESET.name: Solo Faceset
SOLO_FACESET.search_name: Toggle Isolation of Active Face Set
SOLO_FACESET.description: Toggle isolation of the active Face Set, hiding or revealing other Face Sets.

INVERT_VISIBLE.name: Invert Visible
INVERT_VISIBLE.description: Invert mesh visibility: hidden geometry becomes visible and visible geometry becomes hidden.

INVERT_MASK.name: Invert Mask
INVERT_MASK.description: Invert the current sculpt mask so masked and unmasked regions are swapped.

CLEAR_MASK.name: Clear Mask
CLEAR_MASK.description: Clear the sculpt mask by setting the mask value to zero across the mesh.

SHARPEN_MASK.name: Sharpen Mask
SHARPEN_MASK.description: Sharpen the boundary of the current sculpt mask.

SMOOTH_MASK.name: Smooth Mask
SMOOTH_MASK.description: Smooth the current sculpt mask to soften transitions along its boundary.

DECREASE_CONTRAST.name: Decrease Contrast
DECREASE_CONTRAST.description: Decrease contrast in the sculpt mask, making the transition between masked and unmasked areas softer.

INCREASE_CONTRAST.name: Increase Contrast
INCREASE_CONTRAST.description: Increase contrast in the sculpt mask, making the transition between masked and unmasked areas harder.

GROW_MASK.name: Grow Mask
GROW_MASK.description: Expand the sculpt mask into neighboring vertices.

SHRINK_MASK.name: Shrink Mask
SHRINK_MASK.description: Shrink the sculpt mask away from its boundary.

CAVITY_MASK_INVERTED.name: Cavity Mask Inverted
CAVITY_MASK_INVERTED.search_name: Create Inverted Mask from Surface Cavity
CAVITY_MASK_INVERTED.description: Generate a sculpt mask from surface cavities, with the result inverted.

CAVITY_MASK.name: Cavity Mask
CAVITY_MASK.description: Generate a sculpt mask from surface cavities using the current cavity settings.

FACESET_FROM_MASK.name: Faceset From Mask
FACESET_FROM_MASK.search_name: Create Face Set from Masked Area
FACESET_FROM_MASK.description: Create a Face Set from the currently masked region.

MASK_FROM_EDIT_MODE.name: Mask From Edit Mode
MASK_FROM_EDIT_MODE.search_name: Create Sculpt Mask from Edit-Mode Selection
MASK_FROM_EDIT_MODE.description: Convert the current Edit Mode selection into a sculpt mask.

MASK_FROM_FACESET.name: Mask From Faceset
MASK_FROM_FACESET.search_name: Create Sculpt Mask from Face Set
MASK_FROM_FACESET.description: Create a sculpt mask from the Face Set visibility/selection workflow, then reveal the mesh.

MASK_EXTRACT.name: Mask Extract
MASK_EXTRACT.search_name: Extract Masked Region into New Geometry
MASK_EXTRACT.description: Extract the masked region from the sculpt mesh, creating separate geometry from the masked area.

MASK_SLICE.name: Mask Slice
MASK_SLICE.search_name: Slice Mesh Along Mask (Keep in Same Object)
MASK_SLICE.description: Slice the mesh along the sculpt mask without creating a separate new object.

MASK_SLICE_NEW_OBJ.name: Mask Slice New Obj
MASK_SLICE_NEW_OBJ.search_name: Slice Mesh Along Mask into a New Object
MASK_SLICE_NEW_OBJ.description: Slice the mesh along the sculpt mask and place the sliced result in a new object.
